newsitem.title: USA: Penncorp has right to raise cash in merger.
newsitem.headline: Penncorp has right to raise cash in merger.

text.p: PennCorp Financial Group Inc said on Wednesday that it had agreed together with Washington National Insurance Co that it would have the right to increase the cash portion of the purchase price consideration in their $400 million merger agreement.
The cash portion may now be as much as 45 percent of the transaction value, PennCorp said in a statement.

PennCorp also said the two companies had agreed to extend the completion date of the merger to August 30. In November, Washington National Corp said it expected the merger to be completed during the first quarter of 1997.
PennCorp is an insurance holding company that underwrites and markets life, annuities and accident insurance.
